mcp.server.description: Reads and changes the launcher's saved options, the same ones its window shows.
mcp.tool.list_options: Lists every option with its id, kind, group, allowed values, default, current value and whether it is available on this version.
mcp.tool.get_settings: Returns the saved settings: every option's current value, the game's executable and the language.
mcp.tool.set_option: Sets one option to a value and saves it at once. Options tied together change together (generated frames needs DLSS, frame capture needs the diagnostics build).
mcp.tool.enable_option: Turns an on/off option on and saves it.
mcp.tool.disable_option: Turns an on/off option off and saves it.
mcp.tool.reset: Puts one option (id) or every option back to its default and saves. The game's executable and the language stay.
mcp.tool.env: Returns what Play would run with the saved settings, without running anything: the play.ps1 arguments, the switches, and the command lines of the preparing steps.
mcp.tool.version: Returns the launcher's version and commit.
mcp.param.id: The option's id, for example ray_tracing.
mcp.param.value: The new value: on/off (or true/false) for an on/off option, one of the listed values for a choice.
mcp.param.reset_id: The option to put back to its default; leave it out to put every option back.
mcp.param.language: The language of the labels and hints: en or pt-BR. Leave it out for the saved one.
error.not_toggle: '{0}' is not an on/off option. Set it with launcher_set_option to one of: {1}.
error.unavailable_because: '{0}' is not on this version yet: {1}.
